houston-weekly-permits.collection_scope: Four most recent weekly XLSX reports linked on official Sold Permits Search page; all rows in those workbooks. Permit date is an event, not report publication time.
houston-weekly-permits.coverage_limitation: Not complete sold-permit history or electrical/commissioning coverage. No contractor/person/contact fields in these reports. texas-rrc-drilling-permits.collection_scope: All framed permit groups in current daf420.dat plus previous calendar month official end-of-month snapshot. One permit identity; lowest sequence is newest amendment. Older retained entities are never deleted by snapshot absence.
texas-rrc-drilling-permits.coverage_limitation: Not all historical Texas permits. No pending-application feed or older-month correction monitoring. Outages longer than the prior-month overlap can miss activity. Current file over four days old, missing previous-month EOM, changed framing, or bounds fail visibly. Production date, load, fuel suitability, rental demand and contacts are UNKNOWN.
